newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal leases only shipyard to Portuguese company.
newsitem.headline: Senegal leases only shipyard to Portuguese company.

text.p: Senegal has agreed to lease its sole shipyard to Portuguese company Lisnave Internacional S.A, which hopes to expand it to service international shipping, a senior Senegalese official said on Thursday.
Ahmadou Kamara, senior official in charge of the state company portofolio, said Lisnave Internacional had set up a new company to run the shipyard on a 25-year renewable lease.
Lisnave Internacional, based in Almada Portugal, had invested an initial five million CFA francs to launch the new company, Dakar-nave-Chantiers-navals.
The plan, he said, was to increase the capital to 700 million CFA with Lisnave Internacional holding a stake of at least 51 percent.
The new company plans to start operations in March.
The Portuguese company has similar activities in Tunisia, Mozambique and Angola.
